Name: More Random Edition (Randomizer)
Author: Chikakoo
Description:
[b]ABOUT UPDATING:[/b] If you update this mod, there's a chance that the random generation for any given farm will change. Check the update log for how things might be affected.

[b]About seeds and custom images:[/b][*] This mod's randomization is seeded by the farm name. To generate a new set of random things, simply start a new farm with a different name.
[*] For details on how to create your own custom images for the mod, see the readme file in [i]<ModFolder>/Assets/CustomImages[/i] [list][*] Several images will receive random hue-shifts - the readme has more details on how this works
[/list]
[b]Spoiler logs:[/b][*] A spoiler log can be generated to see info about what was randomized
[*] There is a setting to disable this, but it is on by default
[*]A bundle log can be generated (off by default) to show just items required for bundle with shorthand info about where/when to get them (intended to copy/paste into a spreadsheet)

[b]Settings
[/b]This mod supports the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GenericModConfigMenuApi mod[/url] to more easily manage settings. If you do not wish to use this, you can modify the config.json file in the mod folder. This file is created after the first time you launch the game with the mod installed.

[b]Notes About Certain Events:
[/b]The Biome Balance special order, for the sake of simplicity, is mapped to the following in the randomizer:
[*] River = Town
[*] Ocean = Beach
[*] Lake = Mountain

The Trout Derby works differently in the randmoizer:
[*][i]All [/i]fish caught in the forest, town, and mountains have a base 25% chance to award a Golden Tag
[*]This 25% chance is configurable in the [b]Fish -> GoldenTagChance[/b] setting

[b]Feature Summary:
[/b]The following is a list of features - please see the [url=https://github.com/chikakoo/stardew-valley-randomizer]github page[/url] for more details about each option!
[*] Bundle randomization [list][*] [b]IMPORTANT:[/b] DO NOT use remixed bundles if using this feature!
[/list]
[*] Crafting recipe randomization
[*] Crop randomization [list] [*] Credits for the crop sprites not made by us (some images were modified from the originals):
[*] Mizu - permission is assumed from [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/mizus-sprites.136549/]this page[/url]
[*] Bonster - permission is assumed based on the bottom of the mod page for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3438]Bonster's Crops[/url]
[*] Marrorow
[/list]
[*] Fish randomization [list]
[*] Fish have randomized images - most of them are from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3578]More New fish mod[/url]
[*] Specific credits go to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/Users/51209496]Hisame [/url] for the sprites
[/list]
[*] Forageable randomization
[*] Fruit tree randomization
[*] Weapon randomization
[*] Boot randomization
[*] Monster randomization
[*] Farm buildings randomization
[*] Shop randomization (credit to Vertigon for doing the initial work for this)
[*] Randomize museum rewards
[*] Horse/pets/rain graphics randomization - some of these are modified from the [url=https://www.timefantasy.net]Time Fantasy assets[/url]
[*]Daily critter hue shifts
[*] Music randomization
[*] Quest randomization
[*] NPC preference randomizer (credit to Vertigon)
[*] NPC birthday randomization
[*]Garbage can randomization (adds disliked items from nearby NPCs)

[b]Misc Notes and Known Issues[/b]
[*] This mod is multiplayer compatible - just make sure that everyone is using the same config file settings (see the Settings section)

[*] This mod does not fully support other languages (but it does for the most part) [list]
[*] Randomly generated weapon/crop names are English [*] The mad-lib style crop descriptions are English[*] Everything else has been internationalized[/list]
